title: 第23章 铸就根基第24章 家中有事

;;
苏白尘颇为疲惫地回到了玄阴真人那里……哦，顺带还带了他钓上来的那一条鬼鳗。
玄阴真人见他来了，立刻就去帮他收拾这条鬼鳗，并没有多问一句话。
他好像什么都已经知道了。
不过当晚苏白尘在扒拉饭菜的时候还是说：“师父，今天我遇到了那个守关的老将军，他说他要把镇魂剑传给我。”
玄阴真人筷子稍稍停顿了一下，而后道：“嗯，听说了，那是个值得尊敬的人，你别让他失望。”
“可是……”
苏白尘还是有些不甘心，他真不想背这么大的责任。
玄阴真人似乎知道他的心思，说：“你不用担心，谁会将这么大的责任交给你这么个小孩？”
“他把镇魂剑交给了你，其实也等于是交给了我长春阴宗，这个责任自然会有我们阴宗乃至整个长春宫来一起承担！”
“你该怎么样还是怎么样，甚至你若是觉得倦了，也完全可以在宗内另外寻找一人接手这份传承与责任。”
苏白尘闻言这才稍稍安心，如果是这样的话他还是可以接受的。
“别想那么多，你继续按照自己的节奏修炼、生活就好，你所担心的事情也未必真的会发生。”
“来，快些吃着鳗鱼肉，这鬼鳗其实算得上是阴风峡内的特产灵物，难得才会出现一条……倒是没想到今天被你弄回来了。”
“多吃些，鬼鳗肉可以滋养肉身，对你长身体很有帮助。”
苏白尘嗯了一声，便开始安心吃东西了……
从那以后，苏白尘就不着急进行自己的修炼了。
只是每天早上例行修炼一下，上午还是到处闲逛，寻找这阴宗各个偏僻地方‘随机刷新’的前辈。
阴宗有个很有意思的地方，大约是因为这些前辈高人大多明白要给自己留下锚点的缘故，都会在一些偏僻的角落里做着自己奇怪的爱好。
就好像玄阴真人是喜欢美食，钓鱼老头是喜欢垂钓，那水阴姬则是喜欢下海寻找亮晶晶的好看东西。

苏白尘在这过程中又遇到了一些前辈高人，但他大多不会去打扰他们，只是看了看这些前辈高人们的爱好是什么，以此作为参考。
他也是要寻找一个锚点的，现在看起来还是师父的美食爱好最适合他。
而到了下午，他就会去那座阴风峡内的哨塔处，在老将军的看护下拿起镇魂剑继续那剑中先民意志交织的世界。
这既是考验，也是传承的一部分。
如此，时间一天一天地过去。
苏白尘不紧不慢地修炼，更多的时间耗费在了镇魂剑的传承上。
而似乎是接触多了那些上古先民的意志，他的肉身也开始了野蛮生长。
或者说，随着他越来越多地经历那上古的战场，经历每一个先民的身体，他对上古时代人类那强大的肉身有着越来越深入的了解。
而在这种了解下，他也能够尝试在现实中有意识地往那个方向去锻炼自己的身体。
甚至为此他都暂时放下了自己的修行，没有急着完成筑基境的修炼。
他体内的真气只是维持并持续温养着经脉，反倒是从头开始修炼了固本培元这个他甚至可以跳过的筑基初境。
实在是，在他得到的传承中，那些先民甚至可以凭借沸腾的血气将一个强大的鬼物给驱逐……他知道自己不可能变成那样，但总是要尽量往那个方向靠一靠嘛。
然而令他感到不可思议的是，就算他没有刻意地去继续进行筑基的修炼，但他全身经脉依然在这种肉身锻炼下被不断地撑开、拓宽。
他的身体根基正在被不断增强！
原本他的身体只是普通人水平，但是现在随着自己琢磨出来的炼体法门发挥作用，他的身体正在向一个非常夸张的方向蜕变。

Su Baichen returned to Master Xuanyin quite exhausted... Oh, and by the way, he also brought the ghost eel he caught.
When Master Xuanyin saw him coming, he immediately went to help him clean up the ghost eel without asking a word.
He seemed to know everything already.
However, when Su Baichen was eating the food that night, he still said, "Master, today I met the old general who was guarding the gate. He said that he was going to pass the Soul-Suppressing Sword to me."
Master Xuanyin Chopsticks paused for a moment, and then said: "Well, I heard that he is a respectable person. Don't let him down."
"But..."
Su Baichen was still a little unwilling. He really didn't want to bear such a big responsibility.
Master Xuanyin seemed to know what he was thinking and said, "Don't worry, who would give such a big responsibility to a kid like you?"
"When he handed over the Soul Suppressing Sword to you, he actually gave it to me, Changchun Yin Sect. This responsibility will naturally be shared by our Yin Sect and even the entire Changchun Palace!"
"What should you do? Even if you feel tired, you can find someone else in the sect to take over this inheritance and responsibility."
Su Baichen felt a little relieved after hearing this. If this was the case, he could still accept it.
"Don't think so much. Just continue to practice and live at your own pace. What you are worried about may not really happen."
"Come on, eat the eel meat quickly. This ghost eel is actually a special product in Yinfeng Gorge. It's rare to see one... I didn't expect you to get it back today."
"Eat more. Ghost eel meat can nourish the body and is very helpful for your body growth."
Su Baichen said yes and began to eat with peace of mind...
From then on, Su Baichen was no longer in a hurry to carry out his own cultivation.
I just do some routine training every morning, and I still wander around in the morning, looking for seniors who are 'randomly refreshed' in various remote places in the Yin Sect.
There is a very interesting thing about the Yin Sect, probably because most of these senior masters understand that they need to leave an anchor point for themselves, and they will do their own strange hobbies in some remote corners.
Just like Master Xuanyin likes delicious food, the old fisherman likes fishing, and Ji Shuiyin likes to go into the sea to look for shiny and beautiful things.
Su Baichen met some senior experts in the process, but most of them he would not bother them. He just looked at the hobbies of these senior experts as a reference.
He is also looking for an anchor point, and now it seems that Master's food hobby is the most suitable for him.
In the afternoon, he would go to the sentry tower in Yinfeng Gorge, pick up the Soul Suppressing Sword under the care of the old general, and continue the world where the will of the ancestors was intertwined in the sword.
This is both a test and part of the inheritance.
In this way, time passes day by day.
Su Baichen practiced unhurriedly, spending more time on the inheritance of the Soul Suppressing Sword.
And it seems that because he came into contact with the will of those ancient ancestors, his body also began to grow wildly.
In other words, as he experienced more and more of the ancient battlefields and the bodies of each ancestor, he gained a deeper and deeper understanding of the powerful physical bodies of humans in ancient times.
With this understanding, he can also try to consciously exercise his body in that direction in reality.
Even for this reason, he temporarily put aside his own practice and was not in a hurry to complete the practice of the Foundation Establishment Realm.
The zhenqi in his body only maintained and continued to warm the meridians. Instead, he practiced from scratch the initial stage of foundation building, which he could even skip.
In fact, in the inheritance he received, those ancestors could even drive away a powerful ghost with their boiling blood... He knew that he could not become like that, but he always had to try his best to lean in that direction.
However, what was incredible to him was that even if he didn't deliberatelyDi Qu continued to practice foundation building, but the meridians throughout his body were still being stretched and broadened by this physical exercise.
His physical foundation is being continuously strengthened!
Originally, his body was only at the level of an ordinary person, but now as the body-refining method he figured out took effect, his body was transforming in a very exaggerated direction.
